description: Six Schmitt-trigger inverters: each output is the opposite of its input, and the input has a wide gap between the level that reads high and the level that reads low.

inputs.text: The input to one of the six inverters; it counts as high once it rises above 6.96V and does not count as low again until it falls below 4.56V.

outputs.text: 12V while that inverter's input reads low, 0V while it reads high.

notes: This module runs at CMOS levels, not the levels the rest of the plugin uses: its inputs need nearly 7V to trigger, so a 5V gate may never reach the threshold, and its outputs are 12V.
